thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU capacity alert triggered for cluster 'us-west-2-prod' at 06:12 UTC — inference-queue for model-x has grown >5000 pending requests (latency spike, 5xxs increasing). Paging on-call.
alice-oncall: I’m on it. Acknowledge. Checking dashboards + queue.
alice-oncall: quick note — autoscaler logs show repeated failures to create nodes in nodegroup 'gpu-pool-ii': Launch template mismatch + instance profile denied.
ben-platform: hmm did we push a launch-template rotation last night? I pushed a minor tweak to ntp config in the template but shouldn't touch IAM.
carla-infra: I rolled a launch template update to bump image id at 02:07 UTC. Confirmed the new LT references instanceProfile: arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/ri-gpu-role-v2
dmitri-runtime: runtime seeing KV cache pressure because requests are backing up; serving threads saturating GPUs. If scale isn't happening we go to head-of-line blocking.
elaine-sre: can we get the autoscaler logs? kube-bot, dump logs for cluster us-west-2-prod autoscaler controller since 05:50? (no need to include huge output, just tail)
kube-bot: ```
[2026-03-15T05:55:10Z] ERROR scaling: failed to LaunchInstances: AccessDenied: You are not authorized to perform: ec2:RunInstances on resource: arn:aws:ec2:....
[2026-03-15T05:55:10Z] Detail: LaunchTemplateId: lt-0abc123 mismatch with ASG LaunchTemplateVersion
[2026-03-15T05:57:02Z] WARN nodegroup/gpu-pool-ii: taint application failed: pod-controller causing eviction race
[2026-03-15T06:00:01Z] ERROR scaleup: reached max size for ASG gpu-pool-ii (10) , cannot increase
```
alice-oncall: so two problems: 1) ASG hit max-size 10, 2) IAM/launch-template mismatch causing RunInstances to be denied when attempts to create new instances reference the new LT but ASG still pinned to old version.
frank-product: customer impact: several high-priority accounts showing 40-60% increased failures for embeddings and chat completions. CS getting tickets. Gina can you confirm numbers?
gina-cs: Confirmed ~1200 distinct API keys affected since 05:45 UTC. Estimated 18% of requests returning 503/504 for model-x. Major customers A and B seeing latency >10s and timeouts.
ben-platform: possible quick mitigation: increase ASG max size temporarily to 20 and patch LaunchTemplateVersion on ASG to latest version so instances launch with correct instance profile. But need infra approval for IAM changes.
carla-infra: I can bump ASG max and update LT version, but need to ensure instance-profile/role has ec2:RunInstances + ec2:CreateTags allowed. Let me confirm policy.
carla-infra: policy snippet: `Action: ["ec2:RunInstances","iam:PassRole","ec2:CreateTags"] Resource: arn:aws:ec2:*` — role looks okay but the instance profile referenced in LT v2 is in staging account by mistake (human error during build pipeline).
alice-oncall: that would explain AccessDenied. If it's the wrong account we need to change the LT to point to correct instance profile or revert to LT v1.
dmitri-runtime: revert is fastest: point ASG to previous LT version that we know works, that should let autoscaler launch instances immediately (if max size allows). Then we can gracefully rotate.
elaine-sre: agree. Steps: 1) patch ASG to LT v1, 2) increase ASG max to 20, 3) observe scale-up, 4) drain and reprovision later.
ben-platform: I'm going to run the ASG patch and bump max. Doing it now — will post commands.
ben-platform: ```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-ii --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc123,Version=1 --max-size 20 --region us-west-2
``` 
ben-platform: command issued. AWS returned success.
kube-bot: ```
[2026-03-15T06:18:05Z] autoscaling: update accepted for gpu-pool-ii, desiredCapacity unchanged (10), maxSize=20
``` 
alice-oncall: cool. Now trigger a manual scale-up to desired 16 to get nodes ASAP.
ben-platform: ```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-ii --desired-capacity 16 --honor-cooldown --region us-west-2
```
ben-platform: done. ASG launching instances.
kube-bot: ```
[2026-03-15T06:19:12Z] Launch initiated: i-0f1e2d3c ... 6 instances pending
[2026-03-15T06:21:30Z] Instance i-0f1e2d3c passed health checks and joined cluster
```
alice-oncall: node labels/taints check — are the new nodes coming up with gpu=true and taint gpu-reserved:NoSchedule? We need the taint for some priority pods.
dmitri-runtime: new nodes have taint applied but kubelet version mismatch warning for 1 node, but it's minor. Runtime is able to schedule more worker pods onto the new nodes — queue length dropping.
elaine-sre: monitoring: backlog down from 5200 to 800 in ~15m. 5xx rate from 18% -> 6%.
gina-cs: relaying to customers: telling them degraded but partially recovered, ETA 30-45m for full normalization. Customers asking for root cause details.
frank-product: provide short summary: cause = launch template rotation referenced wrong instance profile (cross-account), + ASG max-size too low for surge -> blocked scale-up; mitigation = revert LT version + increase ASG max = restored capacity.
carla-infra: follow-up permanent fix: pipeline will be updated to validate instance profile account and LT version before promotion; add a test that runs `iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy` on new role.
dmitri-runtime: recommend also adding a protective routing rule in Console: if queue > 3k and region saturation detected, route 20% of traffic to dedicated-reserve pool in us-west-2-dedicated.en-platform: noted. We'll add a temporary runway feature flag for emergency cross-pool routing.
elaine-sre: incident severity? Propose Sev2 due to partial outage for multiple customers and degraded SLA.
alice-oncall: +1 Sev2. Logging the incident timeline.
alice-oncall: timeline snippet for postmortem: ```
05:45 - autoscaler started failing LaunchInstances (AccessDenied)
05:50 - queue backlog >3k, initial page fired
06:02 - infra identified LT v2 referencing wrong instance-profile
06:12 - oncall paged, ASG at max-size 10
06:18 - ASG patched to LT v1 and max-size increased to 20
06:22 - nodes joining, backlog decreasing
06:40 - backlog normalized, errors reduced
``` 
frank-product: CS notes: offer affected customers temporary credits and deeper postmortem once root cause fixed.
gina-cs: I’ll draft templated messages. Need exact hh:mm UTC timestamps — will use provided timeline for now.
ben-platform: follow-ups: 1) lock LT promotion until cross-account check added to CI, 2) add autoscaler alarm for "LaunchInstances AccessDenied" to page infra earlier, 3) add ASG surge buffer for gpu pools (reserve 30% headroom by default).
carla-infra: I'll own LT validation and IAM checks. Estimated ETA for pipeline fix: end of week. Will prepare rollback playbook.
dmitri-runtime: I'll add a metric to Console to surface GPU queue vs capacity and an automated soft-fallback to dedicated pool when saturation persists >5m.
alice-oncall: handoff to next oncall @ 08:00 UTC — leaving notes in Ops-runbook channel. If anything regresses ping me.
incidents-bot: Handoff: oncall alice-oncall -> bob-oncall at 08:00 UTC. Incident remains open for postmortem actions.
alice-oncall: closing out immediate page. Marking incident as mitigated. Preparing postmortem draft.
